header.title: Help Center
header.subtitle: Guides for using LMS Nusa's features

labels.tips: Tips & Things to Watch Out For

readingLog.title: Reading Log
readingLog.purpose: Track the books you read and claim a reading incentive from HR.

steps.title: Choose how you're reading
steps.description: Click "E-Book / Personal Book" to report a personal/e-book you've already finished, or "Office Book / SIMAS" to physically borrow a book from the office (this opens the SIMAS system).

steps.title: Fill in the report form
steps.description: In the "Report Private Reading" form, fill in Book Title, Category, Start Date, Review Link (Goodreads/Google Drive), and Cover Photo Evidence, then click "Save Report".

steps.title: Finish a book you're still reading
steps.description: A new log starts as "Draft". If you started reading and haven't finished, click "Finish" once you're done to fill in the review link + evidence photo.

steps.title: Claim the incentive
steps.description: If the book's category isn't Fiction/Magazine and you haven't hit the yearly cap, a "Claim Incentive" button appears — click it to send the claim to HR (status becomes "Under Review").

steps.title: Wait for HR's decision
steps.description: HR will approve or reject your claim. The status will change to "Approved" (with the approver's name) or "Rejected".

tips: The gap between Start Date and Finish Date must be more than 1 day, otherwise the system will block submission.
Incentives are capped at 5 approved claims per year.
Fiction/Magazine categories never earn an incentive.
An evidence photo is required in every flow.
A log still in "Draft" status can be cancelled ("Cancel") if you change your mind.

onlineModules.title: Online Modules
onlineModules.purpose: Take self-paced video courses with a quiz per module and a final assessment, then download a certificate.

steps.title: Start a course
steps.description: In the course list, click "Start" to begin, "Continue" to resume a course in progress, or "Review" once it's at 100%.

steps.title: Enter the player
steps.description: On the course overview page (title, duration, module count, description), click "Process" to start watching.

steps.title: Watch each module's video
steps.description: Watch the video all the way to the end — the next module only unlocks once the current one is finished (sequential, one at a time).

steps.title: Take the module quiz
steps.description: If a module has a quiz, it opens automatically once the video finishes ("Take Quiz"). A module quiz requires a 100% score to pass and unlock the next module.

steps.title: Take the final assessment
steps.description: Once every module is done, take the "Final Assessment" — a minimum score of 80 is required to pass. Below 80, click "Retry" to try again.

steps.title: Download your certificate
steps.description: After passing the final assessment, a "Download Certificate (PDF)" button appears in the course sidebar.

tips: Videos can't be skipped/seeked to fake completion — the system only marks a video complete once it actually plays to the end.
Module quizzes (100% to pass) and the final assessment (80% to pass) have different passing standards — don't mix them up.
Progress on a course in progress can be reset via the (X) "Cancel Progress" button if you want to start over.

participant.label: As a Participant
participant.purpose: View the internal (in-person/online) training sessions you're on, complete the pre-test, post-test, and feedback, then download your certificate.

steps.title: Open a session's detail
steps.description: Click a training session in your list to open its details: schedule, location or meeting link (for online/hybrid sessions), description, and a presentation material link if provided.

steps.title: Take the Pre-Test
steps.description: The "Pre-Test" button (evaluation before the material) only becomes active once the session Host opens it.

steps.title: Take the Post-Test
steps.description: The "Post-Test" button only becomes active once the Host opens it AND your Pre-Test is already completed. A minimum score of 80 is required to pass.

steps.title: Submit Feedback
steps.description: The Feedback form only becomes available once the Host opens it, and — if this session has a post-test — once you've passed the Post-Test (score ≥ 80).

steps.title: Download your certificate
steps.description: Once HR closes/finalizes the session's cost report, a "Download Certificate" button appears for attendees on the participant list.

tips: There's no self-enrollment button for Training Internal sessions — sessions and their participants are set by HR/the Host; you just complete whatever session already shows up on your list.
If a button still looks greyed out/locked, it's almost always because the Host/HR hasn't opened that step yet — not something you're doing wrong.
The certificate only becomes downloadable after HR closes the session, not right after you finish submitting feedback.

trainer.label: As a Trainer / Host
trainer.purpose: Create a training session (HR/HR_ADMIN only), or run a session where you're listed as Host, through to participants — and yourself — getting a certificate.

steps.title: Create a new session (HR/HR_ADMIN only)
steps.description: In Admin Panel → Internal, click "Create Session". Fill in the "Session Details" tab: Title, Date, Start/End Time, Host Name, Event Type (Online/In-Person/Hybrid), Competency, GRI Type, Location or Meeting Link, Material Link, and pick the invited participants. In the "Exam Configuration" tab, build the Pre-Test and Post-Test question sets. Click "Send Invitations" to create the session (or bulk-import via the "Import Data" button).

steps.title: Open Host controls on your session
steps.description: If you're listed as a session's Host, a "HOST CONTROL" badge appears when you open that session's detail on the regular Training Internal page — you don't need to be HR for this.

steps.title: Open each stage for participants
steps.description: There are 3 on/off toggles: Pre-Test Assessment, Post-Test Assessment, and Feedback Form. Switch them on one at a time as participants are ready for each stage — quizzes are auto-scored by the system, no manual grading needed.

steps.title: Monitor participant progress
steps.description: A summary panel shows how many participants have completed each stage ("Completed"); click a count to see who has and hasn't.

steps.title: Close the session
steps.description: Once every stage is done, click "CLOSE SESSION". If there's no training-documentation photo yet, you'll be asked to upload one first.

steps.title: Finalize the cost report
steps.description: Open "Finalize Report": check off who actually attended, upload a documentation photo (if not already set), then fill in Trainer Incentive, Snack Cost, Lunch Cost, and Other Cost — auto-summed into a Total Estimated Cost. This button stays locked ("Session Still Open") until the session is closed in the previous step.

steps.title: Mark it paid
steps.description: Click "Mark Paid" and confirm. After this the report locks ("Report Paid & Locked") and can no longer be edited.

steps.title: Certificates unlock automatically
steps.description: Once the report is marked paid, attendees on the list can download their certificates, and you as Host get your own "Download Host Certificate" button too.

tips: You don't need to be HR to run a session — if you're listed as its Host, the controls automatically appear for you on the regular Training Internal page, not just in the Admin Panel.
Creating new sessions and bulk-importing data both remain HR/HR_ADMIN-only, via the Admin Panel.
If a session needs reopening after being closed, only HR/HR_ADMIN have a "REOPEN SESSION" button.
The cost report can only be submitted once the session is closed — if the button is still locked with "Session Still Open", close the session first.

trainingExternal.title: Training External
trainingExternal.purpose: Submit a request for training outside the company, and — if you have direct reports — approve your team's requests.

steps.title: Submit a new request
steps.description: On the "My Requests" tab, fill in the "New Request" form: Category, Title/Course Name, Vendor, Location, Start & End Date, Registration Fee, Payment Method, and an optional Attachment Link, then click "Submit Request".

steps.title: Wait for your supervisor's approval
steps.description: Your request shows status "Pending (Supervisor)" — your supervisor will see and approve/reject it on their "Team Approvals" tab.

steps.title: HR processes it
steps.description: Once your supervisor approves, status changes to "Pending (HR)" — HR will process the costs and (if this training issues a certificate) upload the certificate.

steps.title: Check the final result
steps.description: Once HR finishes processing, status becomes "Approved". Click "Show Detail" on your request card to see the cost breakdown, learning hours, and certificate (if any).

steps.title: Approve your team's requests (supervisors only)
steps.description: If you have direct reports, a "Team Approvals" tab appears where you can approve or reject training requests from your team members.

tips: The "Team Approvals" tab only appears if you actually have direct reports recorded in the employee data.
"Show Detail" is available on both tabs (My Requests & Team Approvals) to see the full breakdown, including the certificate.
